Reader who acts: the objectui dev seat that takes this card from triage — two Studio surfaces.
Dup check (open + closed): objectui search "machine names instead of labels Explain access contributed by chips flow header trigger object name" → 2 hits, both closed and adjacent: #12693 (Explain principal chips, result banner, Columns chips — those rows now PASS at 4016370a) and #11862 (principal, permission-set list, nav editor, Changes panel). The rows below are surfaces those cards did not cover.

reach: on a stock showcase boot at objectui 4016370af3c9 (framework 5b14b7f3), both rows below render machine names on 2 fresh loads each.

## Rows

- [ ] **Explain access → Evaluation pipeline → Principal resolution → "Contributed by:" chips.** Studio → any package → Access → Explain access; User = a member, Object = any, Operation = Read → Explain. The chips read `org_member`, `everyone`, `showcase_member_default`, `member_default`. Labels exist: `GET /api/v1/meta/position/org_member` → "Organization Member"; `GET /api/v1/meta/permission/member_default` → "Member — Standard Access" (the principal card on the same page already shows these labels). Data source: `POST /api/v1/security/explain`.
- [ ] **Studio flow header subtitle.** `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow%3Ashowcase_resilient_sync` (and other record-triggered flows) reads "Trigger: Record updated · showcase_task"; the object's label "Task" exists and the start-node inspector on the same page shows "Task".

Expected for both: the label, with the machine name secondary (small / muted) if shown at all.

Full evidence: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24570.
